newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reserve Bank of Australia commodity index.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reserve Bank of Australia commodity index.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said its index of commodity prices fell by 0.9 percent in Special Drawing Rights (SDR) terms in April after rising 2.1 percent in March.
Falls in the prices of coal, gold, oil and aluminium were partly offset by rises in the prices of wool and wheat, the central bank said.
In Australian dollar terms, the index was unchanged in April after a 1.3 percent fall in March.
